alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'sock' class visually (confirmed by classifier logit 7.3). It passes most checkpoints: tubular shape, heel contour, fabric stretch, and pattern variety. However, it fails the specific 'ribbed cuff' checkpoint defined in the taxonomy. While many real socks have simple hems, the strict taxonomy requires a ribbed cuff. This deviation prevents a perfect 5.0 score. The missing toe reinforcement is untestable but likely absent. Overall, it is a very good representation of the class, penalized slightly for the missing specific functional component (cuff).
artifact_reasoning: The image exhibits moderate AI artifacts. The primary issues are textural: the polka dot pattern bleeds into the white background (smearing), and the striped pattern on the right sock distorts and merges unnaturally at the heel curve (structural/texture mapping failure). These are classic diffusion model errors where patterns fail to wrap correctly around 3D geometry. The background is also slightly flat/disconnected. While the overall structure is sound (high mask confidence, valid depth), these local textural/geometric inconsistencies lower the artifact score significantly below 5.0. The severity is moderate (noticeable on inspection) but not catastrophic.
